title: [WIP] Adjust objectql to integrate with dataengine plugin
body:
- [x] Understand current ObjectQL implementation and IDataEngine interface
- [x] Create IDataEngine schema in @objectstack/spec
- [x] Make ObjectQL class implement IDataEngine interface
- [x] Align method signatures with IDataEngine requirements
- [x] Update ObjectQLPlugin to register ObjectQL as 'data-engine' service
- [x] Verify the integration works with test files
- [x] Run existing tests to ensure no regressions (1718 tests passing)
- [x] Fix naming collisions and delete method implementation
- [x] Address code review feedback
- [x] Final code review - no issues found
- [x] Clarify data-engine location (should be in spec/system)

## Summary

Successfully implemented the IDataEngine interface for ObjectQL following the three-layer architecture pattern:

**Consumer → DataEngine (ObjectQL) → Driver**

Confirmed `data-engine.zod.ts` should remain in `spec/system/` (infrastructure layer) not `spec/data/` (business metadata layer), following the pattern where system/ contains runtime interfaces like DriverInterface and PluginInterface.

All tests passing ✅
